newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded, diesel prices ease.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded, diesel prices ease.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline and diesel fuel prices eased modestly across the board in late trade on Monday, traders said.
Differentials on October barrels were steady in both markets, leaving basis to track easing November heating oil and unleaded futures in afternoon trade.

A relatively light autumn turnaround schedule, steady influx of barrels from the Gulf Coast and high crude run rates in recent weeks at Midwest refineries have contributed to perceptions of plentiful stocks in the region, traders said.
"It's a great time for somebody to do a major turnaround. I wish someone would," one trader said. "There's a light (turnaround) schedule this fall, and a big schedule this spring."
High sulphur diesel for October deliveries was talked 2.0 cents a gallon under the print in Group Three and 1.75 cents under in Chicago. Low sulphur was steady in both markets.
Group Three unleaded gasoline remained 1.0/0.75 cent a gallon under the print for early October deliveries and 1.75/1.50 cents under for later deliveries.
Chicago unleaded was unchanged at 2.0/1.75 cents under the print for prompt October deliveries and 2.25/2.0 cents under for later deliveries, traders said.
